findings.body:
The regex matches version-looking lines inside multiline settings, rather than identifying the actual top-level assignment. For example, valid TOML `test = '''
version = "fixture"
'''
version = "v1.3.0"
` passed to `set_version(text, "v1.3.0")` changes the contents of `test`. The parsed top-level version already equals the release, so validation accepts the altered setting. This affects the required same-release rerun and violates item 3's preservation guarantee. Locate the actual top-level version value without matching string contents, and verify that this case preserves every other byte.
findings.title: Not done: Your model choices and every other setting in Forge's settings file stay exactly as they were.
